steps.title: Open Sequence Editor and Set Base File
steps.instruction: Launch the Sequence Editor from the TotalChrom Workstation, select the instrument "Clarus 580", choose the desired method (Step 4) for channel A, and specify a fixed base file name and file path that will be used for the result (.RST) and raw data (.RAW) files.

steps.title: Create Sequence Spreadsheet and Save
steps.instruction: In the spreadsheet, fill column "Name" with sample names, column "Number" with alphanumeric sample numbers, align these numbers with vial numbers in column "Vial", and use the "Smart Fill" command to copy the data path into columns "Method" and "Rpt Fmt File" (Report Format File). Ensure the data path in these columns matches the path in column "Data" and double‑check that the base file name is identical. Save the vial list as a sequence file with a .seq extension (an accompanying .idx file is generated automatically). Example files: 190705_CellDeg6B_0h.seq and 190705_CellDeg6B_0h.idx.

steps.title: Start GC Run
steps.instruction: Close any open Editor windows, open the "Setup" menu, select "Sequence" as the Setup type, browse to and select the .seq file created in the previous step, set the same path for "Raw files" and "Result files" (matching the path in the Sequence editor's "Data" column), tick "Start run when ready", and press OK. The run will start automatically; each sample requires approximately 30 min and can be monitored via the "Real‑Time Plot" button.

steps.title: Open Method Editor
steps.instruction: Launch the Method Editor from the TotalChrom Workstation.

steps.title: Configure GC Injection and Temperature Program
steps.instruction: If a method does not yet exist, run the "Startup" wizard under "Create new method" and set the following parameters: Injection temperature = 250 °C; Injection volume = 1 µL; Temperature program: hold 1 min at 100 °C, ramp 5 °C · min⁻¹ to 160 °C, hold 2 min, then ramp 10 °C · min⁻¹ to 240 °C; Carrier gas = N₂ with a flow rate of 50 mL · min⁻¹.

steps.title: Define Components and Internal Standard
steps.instruction: In the Method Editor go to "Components" → "New Component...". Define retention times (RT) for the target sesquiterpenoids (e.g., bisabolene, bisabolol, patchoulol) and for the internal standard β‑caryophyllene. Tick "This component is an internal standard" for β‑caryophyllene and assign it as the internal standard for the target compounds. Save the method (e.g., 190130_BIS_Patch_BisOL.mth) and the associated report format file (190130_BIS_Patch_BisOL.rpt). Note that three β‑caryophyllene peaks are defined; the major peak at 7.71 min is used for IS calculation. An alternative internal standard such as α‑humulene may be used.
